mainEntity.name: When should I get a property survey before installing a fence in Michigan?

acceptedAnswer.text: Get a boundary survey if your property is older than 1980, your deed description is vague, you're uncertain about your boundary line, or you're installing near a corner lot or easement. In Oakland County, surveys typically range from $450-$1,200 — a small investment compared to the $1,200-$1,800+ cost to move a fence after installation or potential legal fees exceeding $3,000 if disputes escalate to court.

mainEntity.name: How does Michigan's Fence Viewers Act help resolve fence disputes without going to court?

acceptedAnswer.text: Michigan's Fence Viewers Act (Act 34 of 1978) requires every township to appoint a fence viewer who resolves boundary fence disputes quickly and affordably. For a $25 filing fee, the fence viewer inspects the property, reviews documentation, and issues a binding decision on repair responsibilities, fence placement, and required modifications — avoiding court costs that can exceed $6,000-$8,000 for similar disputes.

mainEntity.name: What are the fence height limits in Oakland County municipalities?

acceptedAnswer.text: Oakland County has no county-wide fence height ordinance — rules are set by each city, village, or township. Typical limits include: Royal Oak (6 ft rear/side, 4 ft front), Troy (6 ft rear/side, 30 inches front), Farmington Hills (8 ft rear/side ornamental only, 3 ft front), and Birmingham/Bloomfield Township/West Bloomfield (6 ft rear/side, 4 ft front). Always check your specific municipality for exact requirements.

mainEntity.name: Is MISS DIG 811 required before digging for fence posts in Michigan?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, Michigan law (PA 174 of 2013) requires contacting MISS DIG 811 at least 3 full business days before digging for fence posts, poles, or any underground work. This free service has utility companies mark gas, electric, telecom, water, and cable lines at no charge. Never guess — hitting a gas line risks explosion, electrocution, or costly repairs that far exceed the convenience of skipping this step.

mainEntity.name: What is the best time of year to install a fence in Oakland County for longevity?

acceptedAnswer.text: Late August through mid-October offers ideal conditions for fence installation in Oakland County. Ground is workable but not waterlogged or frozen, allowing posts to be set below the frost line (36-42 inches) with time to settle before winter hard freezes. This reduces heaving risk and provides optimal soil conditions for concrete curing and material stability.
